Your bag holds 8 of the 14 clubs. Remove and select to build your set — the Putter always rides along. Upgrades and prestige stay with the club, benched or not.

Upgrades add distance and tighten dispersion. Five levels per club, for every club in the catalogue — bagged or benched. Each prestige tier doubles the coin cost of that club's next set.

A maxed club can trade its levels for a permanent tier: +5% carry per tier, a gold nameplate, and legendary gold at Ⅴ. Costs gems — 15 → 50 → 150 → 400 → 1000. The full rules live in Settings (⚙ on the title screen).

Perks trade one strength for another. Every shot earns its club XP: rank 1 opens its first perk, rank 2 its second, and swapping is free. At rank 3 a second slot (coins) lets both ride. Even Bag rounds play without perks.

One fun ball is featured per day. Complete the Daily Course to unlock the buy — that day only. Rarer designs cost more.

Gems buy prestige and limited editions. Earn them from achievements, quest sweeps, streak sevens, every fifth level and weekly top-tens — or a gem pack.

Pass-and-Play

2–4 players on one phone. Everyone plays each hole in turn — same pins. No coins or stats.

Tees: Pro plays a stiffer wind, scratch. Regular gets a stroke every other hole. Junior gets a stroke a hole, a wider cup, half the wind and no penalty strokes. Honours and the win go by net score.
